title: meniscium reptans
intro: Meniscium reptans, commonly known as Reptan, is a plant species within the family Polypodiaceae and is a type of fern. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Meniscium reptans include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various diseases. Bioactive constituents of Meniscium reptans include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
